task_contract.anchor_definition: The anchor is the first target-specific value-construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: the earliest function, after routing and input preparation, whose own body constructs the target observable value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging the result, or emitting it to the sink.

runtime_boundary.event_plane: DOM CustomEvent on the main document

evidence: The DevTools-visible JavaScript corpus is a single obfuscated bundle and no source map is exposed to the agent.
The target field name is assembled from character-code arrays at the sink, so direct literal search is insufficient.
The target browser fingerprint is carried through runtime-derived transport keys and recovered shortly before console output.
The analysis route gates execution by reading the live probeScope DOM element value rather than stored JS state, making the gate invisible to static analysis.

The target path crosses delegated event handling, single-stage action routing, DOM-state gate checks, tuple construction, asynchronous scheduling, local event dispatch, runtime slot materialization, fingerprint construction, dynamic transport and sink wrapping.
The same single-click run interaction produces non-target probe/audit objects carrying browser_fingerprint-like values before the target fingerprint.scan object.
The deployed bundle also contains canvas-hash-like, state-like and vendor-like decoys that execute or remain reachable-looking without feeding the target browser_fingerprint field.
The target value is separated from the single runAnalysis click by Promise, microtask, timer, animation-frame, MutationObserver and DOM CustomEvent boundaries.
The selected runtime configuration is cloned and mutated in a WeakMap-backed materialization step before the fingerprint encoder receives it.
The final sink receives an already encoded fingerprint value after dynamic cell and lane recovery, so sink inspection alone does not identify the construction site.

challenge_analysis.construct_validity_note: Primary bottleneck is semantic disambiguation among similarly named path functions and decoy fingerprint-like outputs in a large bundle; keyword search narrows high-score candidates but does not replace tracing the fingerprint.scan path.

behavior_category.reason: The observable value is produced by collecting runtime env signals, materializing them as a Uint8Array, and encoding the result as a stable browser fingerprint string. It is not a byte-array transformation, request signature, plain state encoding or request-body rewrite.

near_categories.why_not: While the construction path uses Uint8Array internally, the semantic target is a browser fingerprint derived from platform and capability signals, not a general byte-array transform.
The output has no proof/token/seal semantics; canvas-hash-like code in the bundle is decoy material and does not feed the target field.
The target collects env signals and materializes a fingerprint rather than only formatting UI state.
No network request body is emitted or rewritten; the target is a console-observable fingerprint token.
